$comment: Exam form(s). v1 ships one form; schema is multi-form-ready. Built at S6 per .claude/skills/exam-publish by exam-examiner, 2026-08-18, on the S5 round-1 bank revision (questions.json commit f649943; eval/ round 1 — 65/65 blind, zero bounces, zero dimensions <=2). Selection method (methodology/02-master-inventory.md #priority + /exam-publish step 1): seat priority:high (convergent, sources>=2) concepts first, then fill to the manifest's per-domain format mix; reserves are substitutes, not rejects. This bank maps concepts 1:1 to items, so seating an item seats its concept. Arithmetic verified against the manifest: 50 items = d1 14 (12 SC + 1 MR + 1 SM) + d2 19 (16+2+1) + d3 17 (14+2+1); 46 of the 49 high-priority concepts seated + 4 normal-priority seats; 15 reserve-only concepts (= bank 65 - exam 50). HAND-ADJUSTMENTS (documented per skill): (1) d2 offers 19 high-priority SC items for 16 SC seats, so three highs are reserved on coverage-cost grounds, each the narrowest bullet in an otherwise well-covered outline group — 2.02 (sovereign regions; group 2.1 keeps 2.01/2.03/2.04/2.05/2.06), 2.10 (app hosting; the lowest-scoring d2 high at dim4=4, and its compute-selection discrimination overlaps seated 2.07 containers-vs-Functions), 2.19 (Microsoft Entra Domain Services legacy domain-join; group 2.4 keeps 2.20/2.22/2.23/2.24/2.25). All three stay first-line substitutes. (2) The format mix forces two normal-priority seats: 2.09 and 3.15 are the second multiple_response item in their domain and each domain has exactly two MR seats and exactly two MR items. (3) The two normal-priority SC fills (1 in d1, 1 in d3) were taken from the five hand-demoted Microsoft-pair concepts (gate1-checklist check 7b: C-001, C-012, C-057, C-058, C-061 are corroborated by two independent Microsoft artefacts and demoted only because the vendor counts as one author) rather than from the genuinely single-source normals — 1.01 (C-001, the definition of cloud computing, outline bullet 1.1-1, the only item in the bank testing it) and 3.14 (C-057 Azure Arc, which also keeps outline group 3.3 at three seats alongside 3.15/3.16). Top substitutes are the remaining two of that class: 1.12 (C-012 reliability) and 3.18 (C-061 Azure Service Health). (4) Reserved normals with rationale: 1.10/1.12/1.13/1.14 are the group-1.2 benefit bullets, of which scaling is seated at 1.11; 1.13 is additionally reserved because BO-3 records the bank's one cross-item vertical tension — 1.13 puts the county courthouse pre-adoption with a two-person IT team while seated 3.10 has it running an Azure estate — so the flagged pair does not co-occur on this form (the other eight co-seated verticals were re-read at S6 and are mutually consistent). 2.13 (private endpoints), 2.18 (Azure Data Box), 2.21 (external identities), 3.02 (region and data-transfer cost factors), 3.05 (budget alerts), 3.12 (portal vs repeatable deployment) and 3.13 (Cloud Shell / CLI / PowerShell) are single-source normals; 3.12 additionally carries the bank's only dimension-4 = 3 flag. (5) BO-1 (functional echo) was deliberately NOT used as a selection criterion: 12 of the 17 Gate 2 sample items are seated, including all six d3 monitoring items. Shaping the form around an open Gate 2 question would pre-empt Oliver's decision, and if Gate 2 rules echo unacceptable the bank reworks and this form is rebuilt. 2.25 is seated for the same reason aif-c01 seated its 3-flag items — C-043 (Microsoft Defender for Cloud) is high-priority and no other item covers it — with 2.02/2.10/2.19 as same-domain SC substitutes if the Gate 2 deep read rejects it.
